## Root Cause Analysis

### Exception
Access violation (`0xc0000005`) in the heap allocator.

### Probable Cause
A buffer overflow in the calling module corrupted the heap metadata, causing `ntdll!RtlAllocateHeap` to dereference an invalid pointer.

### Recommended Actions
1. Enable page-heap (`gflags /p /enable myapp.exe /full`) and reproduce the crash.
2. Review recent changes to heap allocation paths in the faulting module.
